## Why This Is Asked

def map_row(row, region):

## Why This Is Asked

## Code Example

```javascript
// Pseudo-MERGE into Iceberg for idempotent upserts
MERGE INTO iceberg.feature_store AS t
USING staging_events AS s
ON t.feature_id = s.feature_id AND t.event_time = s.event_time
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.value = s.value, t.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (feature_id, event_time, value, created_at)
VALUES (s.feature_id, s.event_time, s.value, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);
```
